opportunities.title: Interface in English (i18n)
opportunities.body:
The app UI is Portuguese only. An English UI (and a way to add more languages) would open Zeno to many more users.

Ideas:
- a small dictionary per language in `src/renderer/src/i18n/` and a `t('key')` helper; language from the OS with an override in *Preferences*
- start with the most visible screens (sidebar, request/response panes, workspace screen, import) and migrate the rest gradually
- Go-s
opportunities.why: Small, well-scoped, within ability to write/test code

opportunities.title: feat: add NDJSON / JSONL streaming compressor support for large log exports
opportunities.body:
## Goal
Support streaming NDJSON / JSONL payloads in headroom_shield/compressors.py and sdk/headroom-shield.mjs so multi-line JSON logs get SmartCrusher statistical compression + CCR offloading.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Detect valid JSONL (>5 JSON object lines)
- Preserve error/status>=400 lines and z-score outliers
- Add unit tests in tests/test_headroom_shield.py
